extras: Note: This plugin is being vibe coded.
intentEvidence: A lightweight Obsidian plugin that extends callouts with pipe-separated metadata tokens.
problem: Users need a way to customize the appearance, size, and layout of callouts using simple metadata tokens instead of writing complex custom CSS or HTML.

relations.evidence: Callout Metadata exposes CSS variables that can also be customized using the Style Settings plugin.

summary: A lightweight plugin that extends Obsidian callouts by allowing pipe-separated metadata tokens to control appearance, size, and alignment without custom HTML.
